definitions_are_extracted_not_written: Each definition is taken from the corpus page that owns the term. `definition_kind` says whether the page composed a one-sentence definition or whether this is its opening paragraph.

terms.name: Universal Language
terms.why_it_matters_here: The research programme all of this belongs to. Everything in this codex is one layer of it.
terms.definition: Universal Language (UL) is a research program investigating whether there exists a minimal set of semantic primitives, together with open-ended, invariant-preserving transformation operators, that forms a universal substrate for representing and transforming meaning across natural language, formal mathematics, symbolic reasoning, artificial intelligence, and other representational systems.

terms.name: Universal Symbology
terms.why_it_matters_here: The layer this site is a reference for: how meaning is written down as figures rather than spelled as sounds.
terms.definition: Universal Symbology is the visual and symbolic expression layer of Universal Language — the system of symbols, glyphs, and geometric notations that allow UL to be written, read, calculated, and transmitted across all forms of consciousness (organic, artificial, or cosmic).

terms.name: Composition
terms.why_it_matters_here: How the six marks become an unbounded set of figures. The operators on the landing are this machinery.
terms.definition: The six symbol-features are generators, not the whole alphabet; a small set of composition operators — orientation, scale, count, combination, placement — build every composite symbol and expression from them, as ordered trajectories through the semantic space.
terms.analogy: Like an alphabet of strokes that becomes a limitless script once you can rotate, resize, repeat, combine, and position them — the letters are few, the words unbounded.
terms.predicts: That composition is one operation at every scale (inside a symbol and between symbols), that the transformation layer IS this composition machinery, and that a spoken syllable is the same trajectory as a composite glyph in another medium.

terms.name: Universal Syntax
terms.why_it_matters_here: Which combinations are well-formed. The orbit space is the part of this that has been computed.
terms.definition: Universal Syntax is the syntactic framework of Universal Language — the rules governing how the geometric primitives and UL's algebraic operations combine into valid, meaningful expressions.

terms.name: Universal Grammar
terms.why_it_matters_here: Which well-formed expressions are meaningful, and to whom.
terms.definition: Universal Grammar in the FusionGirl universe is the complete set of structural rules that determine whether an expression in Universal Language is well-formed — meaningful, internally consistent, and interpretable by any conscious system (organic, artificial, or cosmic).

terms.name: Universal Writing System
terms.why_it_matters_here: How the notation is inscribed and read back — the cell, the page, the reading order.
terms.definition: The Universal Writing System inscribes meaning in two layers — a small set of iconic symbol-features (the alphabet: what each mark is) arranged by image-schema spatial relations (the grammar: how marks are placed) — so that the arrangement itself carries meaning.
terms.analogy: Chemistry has atoms and bonds; here the symbol-features are the atoms and the spatial relations are the bonds — a point inside a circle means "contained" because of where it sits, not just what it is.
terms.predicts: That a reader who knows the features and the relations can decode an expression never seen before, because the geometry is iconic — the shape resembles the meaning.

terms.name: Universal Symbolic Geometry System
terms.why_it_matters_here: The geometry the meaning space is mapped onto. This is where the codex's figures acquire coordinates.
terms.definition: The Universal Symbolic Geometry System is the whole framework — a family of symmetry geometries (one per regular polytope) onto which semantics, sound, and structure are mapped, organized by a numerical base ladder and anchored to real symmetry mathematics.
terms.analogy: It is an atlas of shapes-of-meaning: each regular solid (and, one dimension up, each regular polytope) is a chart, and the whole is the collection of charts and the maps between them.
terms.predicts: That there are exactly three distinct semantic geometries in 3D (not five), that expressive richness peaks in dimensions 3–4 and collapses above, and which mathematical toolkit fits which tier.

terms.name: Universal Astrological Symbology
terms.why_it_matters_here: The branch the twelve signs belong to. Those signs are attested from source cards, not derived from the marks.
terms.definition: Universal Astrological Symbology is the branch of Universal Symbology concerned with the astrological symbol tower: how the zodiac's twelve signs, their elements, modalities, cusps and decans arise as compositions of the geometric base symbols rather than as an inherited list of arbitrary glyphs.
